story_type: swimmer rides the cable down to a moving fishing boat, basket hoist
hook: 62 miles out, he rode a cable down to a moving boat.
narration: Sixty-two miles off the coast of Maryland, a Coast Guard rescue swimmer rode the hoist cable down toward a moving fishing boat.
A twenty-three-year-old man aboard the Hannah Boden needed medical help.
From the side door, the flight mechanic runs the hoist and talks the pilot into position, because the pilot cannot see straight down.
Next came the rescue basket, swinging out over the wake.
He sat in the basket as it rose off the deck and climbed toward the helicopter.
At the door, the crew pulled him inside.
Then the cable went back down for the swimmer.
outcome: The Dolphin crew flew him to the Ocean City airport, where an ambulance took him on to a hospital in Baltimore.

location_card.place: 62 miles east of Ocean City, Md.

title: Fishing boat Hannah Boden, 62 miles out
description:
On Aug. 25, 2015, a Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City helicopter crew hoisted a 23-year-old man needing medical help off the fishing boat Hannah Boden, 62 miles east of Ocean City, Maryland.
